tools.name: verify_state
tools.description: Deterministically verify bounded predicates against one exact window. The driver evaluates structured window/accessibility state and may return the final screenshot as uninterpreted visual evidence for a multimodal caller. Predicate results are satisfied, unsatisfied, or unknown; unknown never implies success. Accessibility projections are conservative: absence remains unknown unless the observed search domain is proven exhaustive.

expect.description: One to eight predicates, combined with logical AND.

exists.description:
Assert that at least one trusted element matches the selector.

Element walks are not yet exhaustive on every platform, so absence
cannot be proven. `false` is rejected instead of returning an
indefinitely-unknown predicate.

include_screenshot.description:
Return the final window screenshot as image content for a multimodal
caller. The driver does not interpret that image.

pid.description: Exact process whose window may be observed.
